title_en: An Old Problem in New Clothes
note_en: The particle 地 (de) after an adverb, adjective or idiom shows that a verb follows, which that word describes: 他几乎废寝忘食地复习 "he studied, almost forgetting to sleep and eat"; 全神贯注地听讲 "listened with total concentration"; 沉着地想下去 "keep thinking calmly." It sounds the same as 的, but 的 links a description to a noun, while 地 links it to a verb — much like an English "-ly" adverb.
